phase: slices 1-2 pushed; claim = the two commits below (harness tree at 864a255)

commits.subject: harness (SMB-CONVERT-RASTER slice 1): import-raster route - PNG/JPEG to native through interop-raster + raster_proposal
harness (SMB-CONVERT-RASTER slice 2): export the composite as PNG/JPEG (CLI export + viewer buttons)

capabilities_done: feature import-raster: SourceFormat Png/Jpeg/Webp sniffed before TIFF; PNG/JPEG -> interop-raster decode -> interop-psd raster_proposal -> native package (tiles, receipt key raster, original); WebP refused webp_decoder_unavailable; CMYK in PSD ink convention (non-Adobe CMYK inverted + loss jpeg_cmyk_inverted_to_psd_convention); losses raster_orientation_not_applied, png_animation_not_imported, jpeg_exif_unreadable

view::export: rendered composite (view::render, render-cpu in CLI) -> interop-raster encoders: PNG 8-bit RGB (opaque) / RGBA, untagged sRGB; JPEG baseline quality 1..100 (default 90), 4:4:4 at >= 90 else 4:2:0, transparency flattened on white; decode-back check; atomic write

CLI: export SOURCE (--png | --jpeg [--quality N]) OUT [--overwrite] (feature viewer; without it error feature_unavailable); usage errors exit 2 (no/both formats, quality on PNG or out of range, OUT == SOURCE); open failure exit 1 open_failed; manual + FLAGS updated

viewer: Export PNG / Export JPEG toolbar buttons (widget ids export.png, export.jpeg), path = save field with .png/.jpg extension, refuses the opened source without overwrite; viewer feature now includes import-raster so PNG/JPEG open in the viewer

tests.argv: cargo nextest run -p hsk-studio-harness --features viewer -E 'binary(viewer_export) | binary(viewer_headless) | binary(import_raster) | test(manual) | test(quiet_sources)'

next: lead/validator; possible follow-ups: 16-bit PNG export (render frame is 8-bit only), sRGB/ICC tagging of exports, export quality/subsampling controls in the viewer, R-EXPORT owner decision (export lives in harness view for now)
